# INCOSE HSI Working Group Conferences and Workshops 

Welcome to the archive and current information hub for the INCOSE Human Systems Integration (HSI) Working Group Conferences and Workshops.

## Current Event
- **HSI2027: Navigating Complexity** - The Fourth International Conference on Human Systems Integration will be held in London, UK, from 23-25 August 2027 as part of the 23rd Triennial World Congress of the IEA. See the [HSI2027 conference page](HSI2027/index.qmd).

## About HSI
The Human Systems Integration Working Group advances the integration of human-centered considerations into complex systems engineering.

See the [About page](about.qmd) for more background.
